headline: Broadening but young (2 days, mid-range) on a negative-gamma tape. SPY sits 0.77% under its gamma flip (knife-edge). Vol gap wide but easing. Partial BROADENING_CARRY at 1.00x, contested by DISPERSION_REGIME.

R6 ELEVATED_EASING: gap 23.94 (83rd pctl) but gap_change_20d -0.93. Stress is leaving. Index downside here buys the end of the move. Do NOT route to HIDDEN_STRESS_DOWNSIDE

R11 not triggered: VIX 17.31, well under ~25. Protection is not priced, but the easing gap says it is not needed for stress either

limits: A scenario score is the share of that story's conditions currently met. It is not a probability and was never fitted to history.
This layer does not size, does not name a ticker and places nothing. It produces a family of expressions and a multiplier on the PM's own risk budget.
Freshness (C28): oldest source 2026-10-20 (1 day behind); volatility as of 2026-10-20; positioning (CFTC) as of 2026-10-13, 8 days old. Crowding is context only and cannot time anything.
Dealer gamma readings (SPY/QQQ flip, walls, NEGATIVE regime) rest on an assumed convention: customers long calls and long puts. This is NOT observed data.
The packet also carries SRM, macro_weather, intermarket and thematic sections. Per charter §10.6 (Crown is standalone), they were not used in this read.
Breadth regime is 2 days old with confidence 0.65. The read is early and can reverse quickly.
